summary: Phase 3C-Sort COMPLETED: sorting wrapper + h_mono threading. Phase 3C-UBA BLOCKED: sel_pn_ord unprovable with existing e_n even after sorting; equality case (Monotone gives <= not <) breaks biconditional; modified response function proposed but needs e_n > resp_tau(k) for strict case.

blocking_issues.issue: sel_pn_ord: even with sorted selections (h_mono : Monotone a_bwd), the biconditional a_init(k) < p_n <-> resp_tau(k) < e_n is unprovable because (1) rank-r formula agreement doesn't determine ordering, and (2) equality case a_init(k) = p_n gives False <-> True with existing response function.
blocking_issues.root_cause: Two independent issues: (a) same_side is unprovable from formula agreement alone (fundamental math impossibility documented in 9+ approaches), (b) Tuple.monotone_sort gives Monotone (<=) not StrictMono (<), allowing a_init(k) = p_n which breaks the biconditional even with U(B,A) e_n construction.

resolution_paths.path_1_modified_response: Replace resp_tau(k) with e_n when a_init(k) = p_n. This fixes equality case. For strict case: construct e_n from U(B,A) to guarantee e_n > resp_tau(k_max). Challenge: U(B,A) e_n has only char_k-depth agreement (not rank-r), so losing the forward-game e_n's rank-r formula agreement.
resolution_paths.path_2_composition: Implement full Proposition 12.8.18 (Phase 6E) to compose sub-interval strategies, avoiding sel_pn_ord entirely. Mathematically cleanest but ~500 additional lines.
resolution_paths.path_3_degenerate_elimination: Handle duplicate selections separately: when a_init(k) = p_n, reduce the (n+1)-round game to an n-round game (duplicate positions are redundant). Then remaining positions all have a_init(k) < p_n strictly.
